preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an even length n between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must be of length n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(s[i] == '1' for i in range(n)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists at least one '1' in s, otherwise output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] == b[i] if s[i] == '1' else a[i] != b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i, if s[i] is '1', then a[i] must equal b[i]; if s[i] is '0', then a[i] must not equal b[i].
Both sequences a and b must be balanced, meaning they have an equal number of opening and closing brackets.
